suggestions.suggestion: Implement a health score composite metric that combines data from all active domains
suggestions.details: A single 0-100 'Lifestyle Score' updated daily would provide an at-a-glance health indicator. Weighted by domain importance (sleep heavily weighted, socialization lighter). This creates a gamification-free way to track overall trajectory without individual domain scores feeling prescriptive. The weighting could be personalized over time based on what correlates most with subjective well-being.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a 'What Changed?' weekly digest comparing current week to rolling 4-week baseline
suggestions.details: Beyond daily briefs, a weekly summary showing deltas (sleep up 8%, exercise consistency down, new correlation discovered) would surface medium-term trends that daily views miss. This fits the automation-first philosophy - one weekly touchpoint that covers everything important without requiring daily engagement.

suggestions.suggestion: Design the event schema with explicit causality markers for experiment tracking
suggestions.details: Beyond just logging events, the schema should support marking events as 'interventions' vs 'observations' with optional hypothesis_id links. This makes the experiment framework (OT-P1-2) a first-class data model concern rather than a bolt-on. Events tagged as interventions automatically become candidates for correlation analysis against downstream observations.

suggestions.suggestion: Use sqlite as the only database (so only sqlite and files/folders are used for persistent storage). This is better because it's more portable. This is a personal app, so performance is not an issue. Making this change will make it easier to port as a mobile or electron app later. See scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/storage-steer/SKILL.md
